name: DEEP HOUSE DECKS
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless deep house DJ set. Two decks, warm chords, long blends.
description: DEEP HOUSE DECKS turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an endless deep house DJ set. Every record is generated: a minor-key vamp of Rhodes, organ or pad stabs, a rolling bassline locked to a four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat hats, claps and percussion, now and then a lead hook or a chopped vocal stab. Records unfold in 16-bar phrases with a breakdown and a drop. A virtual DJ blends each into the next: bass swapped on the EQ, filter sweeps, the crossfader across, always into a neighbouring key. Two spinning decks and a moving mixer on screen. Thirteen sets, from Loading Bay to Pool Lights.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
